activityDecision: activityRequiresWeapon is authority supplied by actual selected activity, true for actual combat; false for truly weaponless race/escape; null if unresolved and must surface warning
operationalDefinition: Host supplies ConnectedToTrustedCore and Operational computed from actual canonical alive connectivity and functional drive or weapon authority; present prefab or camera icon does not count. For weapon Operational means lasting ability to fire (ammo/emp/attachment/power), not per-frame cooldown. Physical ground contact must be verified separately in Unity, not faked by this source.
mobility: SelectedDrive must be one of Wheels/Tracks/Omni/Hover; Wheel/CrawlerTrack require functional mounted contact modules on opposite signed X sides, OmniDrive/HoverEngine require at least one functioning matching selected type. An installed disabled or destroyed module is not functional.
impact: Critical warnings ALWAYS shown regardless of suggestions enabled; lack of gun suppressed ONLY when selected activity authoritatively declares weapon not required. No changes to current R3 CanDeploy/StartNextEncounter; launch gate is owner-open and must not be inferred from warnings.

coreCardinalityW15.rule: Count ALL mounted Core parts, including destroyed 0HP and disabled copies; require exactly one total, and require that sole Core healthy, connected to itself, operational. Persisted second Core is not hidden by Health filtering.
coreCardinalityW15.policy: read-only warning; does not change game launch gate or approve save migration
